mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) as of t-1mo predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as reduced short-term rates lower discount rates for equity valuation and increase liquidity.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level against 5-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of low FEDFUNDS periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 215.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 215.0 against 20-day returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and declining labor force (PAYEMS < 130000.0) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days, as weak labor markets reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The interaction term of UNRATE and PAYEMS fails to significantly predict 20-day SPX returns (p > 0.05) in a regression model, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime defined by high housing starts (HOUST > 550.0) and strong residential sales (RSAFS > 350000.0), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over 20 days due to increased consumer spending and economic confidence.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 550.0 and RSAFS > 350000.0 fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) as of t-1mo predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days, as elevated joblessness reduces household income and consumer demand for goods and services.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for UNRATE level against 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative in less than 60% of high UNRATE periods.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO < 95.0 against 60-day returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) as of t-1mo predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days, as increased residential construction boosts consumer spending and economic growth momentum.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST level against 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive in less than 60% of high HOUST periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle characterized by rising FEDFUNDS and elevated CPI (CPIAUCSL > 215.0), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over 20 days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 215.0 fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is positive.
